responsibility: This implementation provides the minimal assertion facility for the mc-boot runtime. Its single exported check reports a fixed failure message through StrIO and then terminates via M2RTS_HALT, giving other runtime libraries and generated code a simple boolean guard mechanism without carrying richer diagnostic state.
same_name_distinction: Runtime implementation half of the Assertion pair: unlike GAssertion.h, it provides the actual failure path by writing the fixed assertion message through `GStrIO` and terminating with `M2RTS_HALT`.
